meta.title: Meet Coach Matt
meta.textType: functional: an interview that gives a person's story, a blog post

paragraphs: Posted by May. This is the first page of my new series about people at our school. On Thursday, January fourteenth, I sat with Coach Matt on a bench at the school field. Leo and Lily stood behind us. Coach Matt is a very kind man, and the children like him. Coach Matt wore a red sports shirt, and he had a silver whistle. Teacher Kim will read my post first, and then she will put it on the blog. "Can you tell us about your job?" I asked.

On the blog page, there is a photo of a football and three facts in bold. Born: a small town by the sea. Job: sports teacher. At our school: six years. These facts are short, but Coach Matt has a long story. I enjoy asking questions, so I asked many.

On the field, a small boy kicked a ball toward the goal. Coach Matt held up a football and smiled. The boy ran back to his friends with a big smile. I wrote in my notebook. "What is your best experience?" I asked. "I like to see a shy child score a goal," he said. "That child begins the year with no friends, and after a month he is happy in the team." "Our team was successful last year, but the happy children are the best part."

Then I asked about his life. "I was born in a small town by the sea," he said. "I grew up playing football on the beach." "I played every day, and I was a student at a sports college." "After college, I became a teacher." "I began my job here six years ago." "Since then, I have helped many students to improve."

"How long have you worked at our school?" I asked. "For six years," said Coach Matt. "How long have you been the football coach?" I asked. "Since my first year," he said. I thanked him, and he went to the field again. I enjoy writing about people, and this was a good start. Do you know a person at our school with a good story? Who shall I ask next?
